newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: IDB grants El Salvador $100 mln in loans.
newsitem.headline: IDB grants El Salvador $100 mln in loans.

text.p: The Interamerican Development Bank (IDB) said on Friday that it has approved $100 million in loans for El Salvador in 1997.
IDB Vice President Nancy Birdsall made the announcement on Friday at the conclusion of a two-day visit to the Central American country.
The money will be set aside for loans to the private sector and could be extended to $200 million if there is enough demand, she said.
From 1992 to 1996, the IDB loaned more than $1 billion to El Salvador to help the country overcome a 12-year civil war that killed an estimated 75,000 people and took a severe toll on the economy.
